name: Black Bean Burger on a Whole Bun
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg and spices and form four patties.
Pan-fry 5 minutes a side.
Build on toasted buns with tomato, lettuce and avocado.

name: Mushroom Swiss Turkey Burger
steps: Shape the turkey into four patties and grill 6 minutes a side.
Sauté the mushrooms, onion and garlic.
Top with Swiss and mushrooms on toasted buns.

name: Pesto Veggie Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas, spread with pesto and top with the vegetables and mozzarella.
Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes.

name: Cauliflower-Crust Flatbread with Tomato, Mozzarella and Basil
steps: Steam, squeeze and mix the cauliflower rice with the egg, parmesan and seasoning; press into a crust and bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more.
Finish with basil.

name: Ham and Pineapple Tortilla Flatbread
steps: Crisp the tortillas and top with marinara, mozzarella, ham and pineapple.
Bake at 425°F for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Pita with Apple Crunch
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with diced apple, celery, yogurt and mustard.
Stuff into the pitas.

name: Salmon Burger on a Bun with Dill Yogurt
steps: Chop the salmon and mix with egg, oat bran, mustard and half the dill; form patties.
Pan-sear 4 minutes a side.
Serve on buns with dill-spiked yogurt and lettuce.

name: Chili Cheese Dog with Turkey Sausage
steps: Simmer the beans with the sauce, chili powder and onion.
Grill the sausages and serve in buns topped with chili and cheddar.

name: Banh Mi-Style Chicken Sandwich on a Bun
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Build on buns with mayo, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Falafel Burger Bowls with Tahini
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, oat flour, garlic and cumin and form patties; bake 15 minutes at 425°F.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and water.
Serve over the salad vegetables.

name: Zucchini Gratin with Parmesan and Thyme
steps: Layer the sliced zucchini in an oiled dish.
Pour over the milk whisked with egg, garlic and thyme and top with parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 28 to 30 minutes.

name: Cauliflower Gratin with Gruyere-Style Swiss
steps: Steam the florets until just tender.
Warm the milk with garlic and nutmeg and melt in half the cheese.
Pour over the cauliflower, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Scalloped Sweet Potatoes with Thyme
steps: Layer the sliced sweet potatoes in a dish.
Pour over the warm milk with garlic and thyme and dot with butter and parmesan.
Bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Creamed Kale with Garlic
steps: Wilt the kale with garlic.
Stir in the cream cheese, milk and parmesan until creamy.

name: Garlic Mushroom Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the mushrooms and garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley.

name: Rosemary Roasted Turnips
steps: Toss the cubed turnips with oil, rosemary, garlic and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.

name: Spaghetti Squash Gratin with Spinach
steps: Roast and shred the squash.
Mix with the wilted spinach, ricotta and garlic.
Top with cheeses and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: Butternut Squash Mash with Sage
steps: Roast the squash until soft.
Mash with butter, sage, nutmeg and milk.

name: Stuffed Zucchini with Quinoa and Feta
steps: Scoop the halved zucchini.
Mix the quinoa with the chopped flesh, tomatoes, onion, oregano and feta.
Fill and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes.

name: Cheesy Eggplant Parmesan Rounds
steps: Roast the eggplant rounds brushed with oil.
Top each with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 10 minutes more and finish with parmesan and basil.

name: Loaded Sweet Potato Skins with Black Beans
steps: Bake the sweet potato halves and scoop out most of the flesh.
Fill with beans and cheddar and bake 10 minutes.
Top with yogurt, salsa and cilantro.

name: Turkey Bacon-Wrapped Asparagus Bundles
steps: Wrap bundles of asparagus in turkey bacon.
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.

name: Salsa Verde Chicken Roll-Ups
steps: Pound the chicken, layer with spinach and cheese, roll and secure.
Sear, then bake in the salsa verde at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Lemon Herb Turkey Cutlets with Green Beans
steps: Pound and season the cutlets and sear in oil, 3 minutes a side.
Steam the green beans.
Finish the cutlets with lemon and herbs.

name: Chicken Thighs with Olives and Tomatoes
steps: Brown the chicken in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, tomatoes, olives, oregano and wine and braise covered 30 minutes.

name: Spice-Rubbed Turkey Tenderloin with Roasted Carrots
steps: Rub the turkey with oil and spices.
Roast on the carrots at 400°F for 35 minutes and rest before slicing.
